'''Symphony Limited''' is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[electronics]] and [[home appliances]] company, that specializes in manufacturing [[air coolers]]. It is based in [[Ahmedabad]] and was established in 1988.<ref>{{cite web|title=SYMPHONY LTD|url=https://www.ibef.org/industry/indian-consumer-market/showcase/symphony-ltd|access-date=15 July 2021|website=[[India Brand Equity Foundation]]}}</ref> It is a public limited, listed company,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-article/symphony/news/SCS04|title=Symphony News: Latest News Updates on Symphony, Symphony Results News, News on Symphony for last 6 months, Symphony Share/Stock News|website=Moneycontrol.com}}</ref> with operations in about 60 countries.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/symphony-to-double-india-network/article20419700.ece1|title=Symphony to double India network|first=Virendra|last=Pandit|website=Thehindubusinessline.com|date=10 April 2012 }}</ref>

== History ==
Initially incorporated as Sanskrut Comfort Systems Ltd. (SCS) in 1988 that manufactured consumer durables under brand name ‘Symphony’.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/symphony/history.html#1614623400|title=History of Symphony Ltd., Company|website=Goodreturns.in}}</ref> Symphony went public in 1994 and was also listed at [[Bombay Stock Exchange|Bombay]], [[Ahmedabad Stock Exchange|Ahmedabad]] and [[Delhi Stock Exchange|Delhi]] stock exchanges.<ref>{{cite web|website=Symphonylimited.com|title=Public|url=http://www.symphonylimited.com/about-us/history-and-milestones.html}}</ref>

In 1994, the company briefly diversified into the household electrical appliances sector in order to counter the seasonal nature of the air cooler business. Between 2002 and 2004, Symphony exited all other categories and resumed manufacturing only air coolers.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/how-symphony-got-its-rhythm-back/103164|title=How Symphony got its rhythm back|website=Fortuneindia.com|date=3 May 2019 }}</ref>

In 2006, Symphony acquired the Mexican assets of the International Metal Products Company (IMPCO) for $650,000. IMPCO's large commercial air coolers were deployed in India in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://qz.com/india/856859/symphony-limited-an-indian-tycoon-founded-the-worlds-top-air-cooler-firm-giving-shareholders-91000-returns-in-a-decade/|title=An Indian tycoon built the world's top air-cooler firm, giving shareholders 91,000% returns in a decade|first=Manu|last=Balachandran|website=Quartz India|date=21 December 2016 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|website=Symphonylimited.com|title=Industrial Cooler|url=http://www.symphonylimited.com/about-us/history-and-milestones.html}}</ref>

In 2015, Symphony acquired Chinese air cooler company Munters Keruilai Air Treatment Equipment (Guangdong) Co. Ltd. (MKE) that owns the brand Keruilai, for {{INR}}1.5 crore.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/symphony-ltd-acquires-chinese-air-cooler-company-115081301420_1.html|title=Symphony Ltd acquires Chinese air cooler company|date=13 August 2015|website=Business-standard.com}}</ref>

In 2018, Symphony purchased 95% equity stake in Climate Technologies, an Australian manufacturer of cooling and heating products, at a valuation range of A$40–44 million.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vccircle.com/air-cooler-maker-symphony-to-acquire-australias-climate-technologies|title=Air cooler maker Symphony to acquire Australia's Climate Technologies|date=22 June 2018|website=VCCircle.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/CorpAttachment/2018/6/37cf3bd4-7bb9-4e7d-b4c2-db57b1f243d8.PDf|title=Symphony signed an agreement to purchase effectively 95% equity stake in Climate Technologies Pty Limited, Australia|website=Bseindia.com|access-date=28 March 2022}}</ref>

== Operations ==
About 25-30 percent of Symphony's turnover comes from international markets of Mexico, Europe, United States, West Asia and South-East Asia.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/symphony-acquires-chinese-air-cooler-major-mke/article7535219.ece|title=Symphony acquires Chinese air cooler major MKE|first=Rutam|last=Vora|website=Thehindubusinessline.com|date=13 August 2015 }}</ref>
